detail.longDescription: Marketing teams juggle a lot: capturing leads, nurturing them across channels, tracking campaign performance, and personalizing every touchpoint—all while managing an ever-growing stack of tools. Doing that manually isn't just time-consuming—it's unsustainable. That's where marketing automation comes in. Now you can start from the AI tool you already work in. Add Zapier to your AI assistant, describe the campaign you want running, and your agent turns it into a Zap. Zapier takes over from there
